scripts.build: yarn workspaces foreach --all --exclude transition-public --topological-dev run build
scripts.check: yarn workspace common check && yarn workspace geocoder check && yarn workspace backend check && yarn workspace frontend check
scripts.codegen: yarn workspaces foreach --all --exclude transition-public run codegen
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "yarn workspace backend dev" "yarn workspace frontend dev"
scripts.fix: yarn workspaces foreach --all --exclude transition-public run fix
scripts.start: yarn workspaces foreach --all --exclude transition-public run start
scripts.test: yarn workspaces foreach --all --exclude transition-public run test
scripts.test:coverage: yarn workspaces foreach --all --exclude transition-public run test:coverage
